issue_request: Published FHIR-core change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking FHIR-I to clarify why the conformance-rules list of modifier elements grouped some resources in one bullet while other status elements appeared individually.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by commit 82d58b83174a490cfdc312007ac0e1387e3ba3f6 (GF#16931 / svn revision 14215), which changed source/conformance-rules.html to replace the misleading grouped status/experimental bullet and changed the then-current MetadataResource spreadsheet so experimental was no longer marked as a modifier.
additional_context: The conformance rules page is still in build scope through source/hierarchy.xml and linked narrative pages. The old MetadataResource spreadsheet was deleted during the 2021 source rework, while current source/fhir.ini lists CanonicalResource and MetadataResource as active interface resources; current CanonicalResource keeps status as a modifier and leaves experimental without isModifier. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision for this narrow issue.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. Current source/conformance-rules.html already says most status elements are modifiers because of entered-in-error and then introduces other modifiers via the generated modifier-list placeholder, which is the intended grouping clarification.
